subject: Kickoff: BrightLeaf quality-signal onboarding and eval hooks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: BrightLeaf quality-signal onboarding and eval hooks

Hi Alice,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday — excited to get BrightLeaf onto Redwood's quality monitoring (QSignal) pipeline. Goal for this thread: land a clear implementation plan for prompt sets, eval harness integration, and canary/rollback thresholds so the CS <> Engineering handoff is clean.

Quick agenda / asks prior to our kickoff:
- Can you share a representative subset of production prompts (PII redacted) or synthetic examples? CSV is fine.
- What success metrics matter most: accuracy/TPR/false positive tolerance, latency SLOs, and any privacy constraints?
- Any required evidence for compliance teams (audit logs retention, model access lists)?

Suggested canary defaults we typically use (we'll tune with you):
- Quality: >=5% relative drop in top-line prompt accuracy triggers rollback to previous model variant.
- Latency: 30% increase in 95th percentile latency triggers fallback to lower-cap model.
- Error rates: absolute error rate >1% for safety-critical prompts triggers immediate pause and notify.

Attachments: kickoff-deck.pdf (stub).

Propose a 60-minute technical kickoff with CS, Eng, and Security — are you available Mon Aug 10 or Tue Aug 11 (US morning)?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

> Thanks for taking the call yesterday — excited to get BrightLeaf onto Redwood's quality monitoring (QSignal) pipeline.

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear outline. Monday Aug 10 at 10am PT works for us.

I've attached a first-pass prompt set (brightleaf_promptset_v1.csv) and a short doc with our success criteria: BrightLeaf cares most about clinical-term precision and latency under 300ms p95. Legal will want to see audit logs and an ingestion checklist before any private deployment.

Two small asks from our side:
- Can you confirm what evidence you surface in the console for regressions (examples of an alert email + Playbook link)?
- We have a couple of safety-critical prompts used at triage; please mark those so we can ensure stricter rollback thresholds.

Alice Chen

alice@brightleafhealth.com

Date: 2026-08-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: BrightLeaf quality-signal onboarding and eval hooks

Folks — forwarding BrightLeaf's reply and prompt set. Marissa / Lauren: can you take point on the implementation? Key asks from Alice:
- Integrate BrightLeaf prompt set into our eval harness so we can baseline current model and generate regression alerts.
- Flag safety-critical prompts (they marked 8 rows in the CSV). Use stricter thresholds for those (we propose 3% relative drop triggers immediate rollback).
- Provide a sample alert + playbook to send to their Legal team for audit purposes.

Plan I propose (short):
1) Marissa: spin up an eval harness job using the provided CSV — baseline against current hosted model variant and produce a prec/rec report.
2) Lauren: prepare the CS handoff doc with runbook, who owns on-call, and the canary SLOs.
3) Jonas: coordinate kickoff meeting and confirm DocuSign/HubSpot items for procurement.

Can you each reply with ownership + ETA? Need this ready before the Aug 10 kickoff.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kickoff: BrightLeaf quality-signal onboarding and eval hooks

Acknowledged — I'll own the eval integration. Summary of my immediate plan and asks:
- I'll kick off an eval harness run against the attached brightleaf_promptset_v1.csv and produce baseline metrics by EOD Aug 4.
- For safety-critical prompts (rows flagged), I'll set a canary with a 3% relative drop threshold and a low-latency guard: if p95 latency >350ms (their p95 target is 300ms) we'll trigger a fallback to the smaller quantized variant.
- I'll upload the harness config and canary policy to the Drive folder and attach the YAML here (eval_harness_brightleaf.yaml, canary_policy_brightleaf.md).
- I need a test tenant API key and a short sample of production traffic logs (or synthetic replay) to validate KV cache behaviour.

Attaching: eval_harness_brightleaf.yaml, canary_policy_brightleaf.md (stubs). ETA: baseline report by 2026-08-04T17:00-07:00.

—Marissa
